messages.subject: S1 done: heading scan, slugs, TOC render
messages.body: Implemented (tests first, red then green) mdtoc/toc.py with fence-aware ATX heading scan, GitHub slugs with -1/-2 duplicate suffixes, and nested TOC render, and wired 'mdtoc --stdout FILE' to print the TOC without writing (AC-2, AC-3). Branch fleet/build-s1, head 50560a1 (committed, not pushed); 'python3 -m unittest discover' passes 20/20 tests. Left for later slices: in-file update/markers (S2), --check, and multi-file/error aggregation; default depth is H2-H4 and --max-depth is passed through to render but not range-validated.
